about: The str_pad verb in a specification (TEXT-2). A positive width beyond any representable length is admitted. A missing source gives missing without needing the width, while padding a present value, even the empty text, to that width would build text longer than one text value may hold, 1 MiB (TEXT-2), and refuses the whole run without a length it cannot count. str_pad declares no handler, so the successful run reports no handler row. Moved from the declarative_text_pad module of scalar_declarative_rounding.rs, whose test compared the handler counts, the saved bytes, and the refused run's one issue at its phase, condition, rule, spec paths and context.
